verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt index at docs.followupboss.com (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of the docs pages. Their frontmatter declares an agentTools projectIndex pointing back to llms.txt, and the marketing site serves its own llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404) and any evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.followupboss.com/llms.txt # Follow Up Boss Documentation
Follow Up Boss is a CRM, not a lead provider or website company: it works with the lead sources, websites and tools a team already uses.
